author: Inside Edition
description:
After the South Carolina Supreme Court overturned Alex Murdaugh’s double murder convictions, Inside Edition’s Eva Pilgrim sat down with defense attorneys Dick Harpootlian and Jim Griffin for an extended interview about what comes next in the case.

Harpootlian and Griffin address Alex’s reaction to the ruling, what they believe changes the game heading into a retrial, whether a plea deal is on the table, and much more.
title: Extended Cut: Eva Pilgrim's sit down with Murdaugh lawyers, Jim Griffin and Dick Harpootlian

author: Inside Edition
description: Is the pontiff in the market for a new Popemobile? His Holiness was the first one to get a look at the new, fully-electric Ferrari. Not that he has to worry about driving himself anywhere, Pope Leo sat in the driver's seat of The Luce, while Ferrari representatives talked him through all the features of the vehicle. The pontiff didn't bother with a test drive. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Pope Leo Gets First Look At Fully-Electric Ferrari Luce
